newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport names passenger services head.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport names passenger services head.

text.p: Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said it has appointed Bernd Struck as manager of its new passenger services unit from July 1.
Struck, currently United Airlines' Germany and Austria general manager, will be responsible for all passenger-related services at Frankfurt airport.
The unit, created at the start of 1997, includes terminal operations, contracting, air safety and the airport conference centre, an FAG statement said.
Struck, currently also chairman of Barig, the association of airlines flying to Germany, has been United's Germany manager since 1994.
